requirements.R_OPERATOR: Operator reaches READY with matching controller and control-plane digests and a stable second-run report_digest.
requirements.R_TF_LT: Planned launch template pins approved AMI, IMDSv2 hop 1, and an instance profile.
requirements.R_TF_POLICY: Planned IAM has the four Allow Sids without wildcard actions; SG is ALB-scoped; EBS is encrypted.
requirements.R_PROVENANCE: Controller release identity and launch-template provenance match the approved artifact with stable integer slots and no public IPs.
requirements.R_ROLLOUT: Pilot-then-wave events, generation bump, lost-reply resume, and fail_pilot/fail_wave preservation hold.
requirements.R_FENCE: Stale owner and mid-operation target-release changes fail closed.
requirements.R_PLACE: Subnet reorder keeps placements; public IPAM subnets and invalid manifests fail closed; odd fleet with extra AZ stays private.
requirements.R_JOURNAL: Torn tails are truncated; interior corruption fails with invalid interior journal record.
requirements.R_DRIFT_IMPORT: Manual drift is report_only; legacy Slot tags recover identities and moved addresses.
requirements.R_TOKEN: Attachment tokens use canonical generation, instance_id, and volume_id.
requirements.R_ANTICHEAT: Forged READY reports cannot survive a real operator run.
requirements.R_PRESERVE: Submitted sources and baked IPAM catalog remain present.
